Each request counts as the slice it takes out of that model's monthly credits , and all the slices add up to one plan. Pro works the same way: 16 credits in any 5 hours and 40 in any 7 days across its per-model credits - premium models included - worth up to $22 / $55 of usage on a $110 model like Ling 3.1 Flash, or $16 / $40 on an $80 model like GLM-5.2. Go runs the same mechanism on a smaller pool: 3 credits in any 5 hours and 6 in any 7 days across its per-model credits , out of a 10-credit monthly pool - worth $3 / $6 of usage on a full-allowance model. Subscribers on the older flat $10 Go plan already have the same $3 / $6 windows, so nothing changes when their next billing cycle moves them over. Caps are measured in credit value , not request count - so how many requests fit inside a window depends on the models you run.
